description:
Verso: writing exercises in Hebrew and Arabic, and the beginning of a letter in Arabic script. The Judaeo-Arabic jotting in the upper margin is in the hand of Avraham Maimonides, a draft for the beginning of an order or request addressed to al-Talmid Abū Saʿd. Also mentions Abū Manṣūr.

The Arabic section could either be a draft or a remnant of an actual letter. It begins: . . . الامور التي تصدر عن معلومات مولانا وسيدنا . . . لرضايه واهداه برضاه . . . الى الشكر . . . المنعم الفاضل . . . 

Recto: Genesis 19:31-35. 

(Information in part from CUDL)
description_he: צד א: בראשית י'ט:31–35. צד ב: תרגילי כתיבה בעברית ובערבית, ותחילת מכתב בכתב ערבי.
